title: Fraglingo: Molecular Design via Attachment-Aware Autoregressive Fragment Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.13519v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Molecular design is most effective when generation mirrors the edits chemists actually make: extending a scaffold, replacing a substituent, or decorating a scaffold at a specified attachment site while optimizing molecular properties. Fragment-based molecular design naturally supports this workflow, yet existing approaches often separate fragment selection from attachment prediction, first choosing a fragment from a fixed vocabulary and then predicting how it should be connected. This decoupling restricts generation to a closed fragment vocabulary and treats attachment as a separate prediction problem. We introduce Fraglingo, an autoregressive fragment-based molecular generator that jointly models fragment identity and attachment in a continuous latent space. translated_title: Fraglingo：基于连接感知的自回归片段生成实现分子设计
translated_abstract: 当生成过程能够模拟化学家实际进行的编辑操作时，分子设计最为有效：扩展骨架、替换取代基，或在指定的连接位点修饰骨架，同时优化分子性质。基于片段的分子设计天然支持这一工作流程，然而现有方法通常将片段选择与连接预测分离——先从固定词表中挑选一个片段，再预测其应如何连接。这种解耦将生成限制在封闭的片段词表内，并把连接视为一个独立的预测问题。我们提出了Fraglingo，一种基于自回归片段的分子生成器，它在连续潜在空间中联合建模片段身份与连接方式。Fraglingo预测一个连接感知的片段嵌入，并通过潜在空间的最近邻搜索来检索下一个片段。为了编码连接上下文，我们引入了一个（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Fraglingo提出了一种自回归片段分子生成方法，在连续潜在空间中联合建模片段选择与连接方式，通过连接感知的片段嵌入和最近邻检索，突破固定片段词表的限制，更贴近化学家的实际分子编辑工作流程。
